notes.title: The Last Show of Robert Chardish: Act 1
notes.content:
[i]"I didn’t expect the gravity of loss and loneliness that surrounds The Last Show of Mr. Chardish"
~COG Connected[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35941883/36a48dda85b8ddb317b693623a61557f0ed5403b.png[/img]

Released in September [b]“The Last Show of Robert Chardish: Act 1"[/b] is a prologue to the full version of "The Last Show of Mr. Chardish". An adventure game based on exploration and solving puzzles.

The leading role is Ella, an actress who returns to the theatre where she once worked. While wandering, take care of putting the mask on, the world around will show the secrets of Robert Chardish, director and visionary that was close to her.

[i]"...a unique art style mixed with multiple chapters of unique controls and mechanics..."
~HappyGamer[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35941883/16e69d73a4d590cd7b1a77d5a5ca542917112b30.png[/img]

Explore the surrounding art prepared by Punk Notion and Hydra Games, set up limits of imagination, and enter the world created by VR technology. 

[i]"The Last Show of Mr. Chardish will break your heart"
~Kotaku AU[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35941883/392236b5ff2fbd3c40debefc82570dcbfc8a7d59.png[/img]

"The Last Show of Mr. Chardish" is a part of [b]The Steam Game Festival - Autumn Edition[/b]. 

See you at the show,

[i]Punk Notion and Hydra Games[/i]

notes.title: The Last Show mentioned by: Kotaku, HappyGamer, COGConnected!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[b]"The Last Show of Mr Chardish"[/b] is being mentioned by different bloggers on multiple websites, and receiving such a greach feedback. We're glad that our game is leaving a positive impact on everyone who played it.

In the previews you can find some extremely poetic quotes that explain how players are bonding emotionally with the game. They're also mention defining game's uniqueness by the different art styles that are featured in it.

[url=https://www.kotaku.com.au/2020/09/the-last-show-of-mr-chardish-pax-online/]"The Last Show of Mr. Chardish will break your heart"[/url]
~Leah Williams, Kotaku

[url=https://happygamer.com/the-last-show-of-mr-chardish-now-has-a-free-prologue-available-on-steam-80855/]"...a unique art style mixed with multiple chapters of unique controls and mechanics..."[/url]
~Joshua Goodpastor, Happygamer

[url=https://cogconnected.com/preview/pax-online-last-show-mr-chardish-preview]"The Last Show of Mr. Chardish hits deep and I am a little shock"[/url]
~Alexander Thomas, COGConnected

[b]Don't forget to click the quotes[/b]

We are aslo inviting you to the theatre for the "Act 1" of our Show which is Available Now!:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1397140/The_Last_Show_of_Mr_Chardish_Act_I/

And don't forget to add [b]"The Last Show of Mr. Chardish"[/b] to your Steam Wishlist!

notes.title: Free prologue to “The Last Show of Mr. Chardish“ available on September 3rd
notes.content:
Hi guys! 

The free prologue “The Last Show of Mr. Chardish“ is coming on [b]September 3rd 2020[/b]!

Prologue’s title is: “The Last Show of Mr. Chardish: Act I" and it’s an introduction to the game's world and history. In a game you’ll meet the main character, Actress Ella, and help her solve first secrets about Robert Chardish

On the occasion of the release we've planned a [b]second livestream[/b] of “The Last Show of Mr. Chardish: Act I" with developers. 

[h3]Join us [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1397140)]HERE[/url]
on 3rd September 3rd 2020 at
11AM PST, 2PM EDT, 8PM CEST.[/h3]

Remember that a [b]live chat[/b] will be available through the whole stream, so you can ask any game related questions.

We can’t wait to hear what you all think!

See ya!
